name: Research desk
description: Question -> sources -> evidence comparison -> cited brief. Produces citations, uncertainties, and an inspectable source set.

steps.title: Gather sources: {{question}}
steps.deliverable: Source list with URLs/paths and retrieval dates
steps.acceptance: Each source is retrievable; retrieved vs verified is stated.
steps.instructions: Collect sources for {{question}}. Record URL or path, retrieval time, and a one-line summary. Mark each as retrieved only.

steps.title: Compare evidence: {{question}}
steps.acceptance: Each claim maps to at least one source; disagreements noted.
steps.instructions: Compare the sources for {{question}}. Build a claim table and flag uncertainties.

steps.title: Cited brief: {{question}}
steps.acceptance: Every claim cites the evidence table; uncertainties preserved.
steps.instructions: Write a brief answering {{question}} with inline citations and an uncertainty section.
